recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-17432 unless a later resolved issue changes ObservationDefinition.code's datatype or binding.
issue_request: FHIR-17432 is a Published/Persuasive OO change request raised against the STU3 draft ObservationDefinition resource. It asked to change ObservationDefinition.code from Coding to CodeableConcept so labs can represent a local test code while waiting for a LOINC code.
initial_application: No current git commit explicitly names FHIR-17432, but Jira says the draft-resource to-do was already applied. Git history shows the historical ObservationDefinition spreadsheet originally used Coding for ObservationDefinition.code and the August 29, 2018 ObservationDefinition connectathon update changed that row to CodeableConcept. OO WGM minutes for September/October 2018 also list tracker 17432 and state the change was already applied.
additional_context: ObservationDefinition remains active in the current FHIR build as a draft resource in the observationdefinition folder and OO work group. A later same-element issue, FHIR-54595, is only Triaged/Unresolved and concerns the example value set binding for ObservationDefinition.code, not the datatype requested by FHIR-17432.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/observationdefinition/structuredefinition-ObservationDefinition.xml defines ObservationDefinition.code as 1..1 CodeableConcept, and current-source searches found no remaining Coding datatype for that element.

related_jiras.note: Later Triaged/Unresolved ballot issue for the same element's value set binding; it is not a final datatype decision and was not decided here.
